results.question: Is there a pool on base and when is it open?
results.answer:
Yes, the **Quantico Pool** is next to The Clubs at Quantico, but it's likely closed for the season. The saved page says it's open only for Active Duty lap swim and military training from mid-May to the last Friday in September. The latest posted hours (as of 10/26/2026) only run through September 7, so there's nothing posted for now.

Call 703-784-2973 to confirm. Details: [Pools](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation/swimming)

Want to know about indoor options like the Barber Physical Activity Center?

results.question: How much does child care cost on base and how long is the wait?
results.answer:
**Fees are based on total family income** and follow the Department of Defense fee structure, so there's no single price. The site doesn't list wait times either. If space isn't open, your child goes on a waitlist and you're offered a spot by email when one opens (as of 10/26/2026).

For fee and waitlist questions, call CDC North at 703-784-4470 or CDC South at 703-784-3652. Details: [Child Development Centers](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/child-development-centers). Want the steps to sign up?
followups: How do I sign up for child care?

results.question: How do I book a room at the Inns of the Corps?
results.answer:
Call the **24/7 Reservation Center at 1-888-409-7829**, or email groups to LodgingReservations.Quantico@usmc-mccs.org. Online booking is available through the lodging site, but I can't book for you.

Booking windows (as of Oct 26, 2026): **PCS families up to one year ahead, TAD/TDY 90 days, leisure 30 days.** A credit or debit card and valid credentials are required at check-in.

Details: [Inns of the Corps Quantico](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/lodging/inns-of-the-corps). Want the eligibility list?

results.question: How far ahead can I book?
results.answer:
It depends on your priority category at the Medal of Honor Golf Course (as of 2026-10-26):

- **Active-duty military:** 10 days ahead
- **Members:** 9 days
- **Retired military, veterans, DoD:** 8 days
- **General public:** 7 days

First-time online users default to General Public. Show your ID at the Pro Shop so they can move you to the right category. Want the course hours?

[Book a tee time](https://www.chronogolf.com/club/medal-of-honor-golf-course) or see the [Golf Course page](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness/recreation/outdoor-recreation/golf-course).
